This beginner-friendly Dance Workshop offers an engaging, low-pressure environment focused on recreational movement and creative expression. The session begins with a guided full-body warm-up, followed by step-by-step instruction in accessible choreography set to popular music. Participants will learn fundamental rhythm patterns, practice short routine combinations, and engage in group movement exercises designed to promote physical wellness, stress relief, and enjoyment through dance regardless of prior experience.

The ACM Hackathon is a collaborative, fast-paced software development event where students work individually or in teams to design, build, and deploy technology projects. Throughout the event, participants will engage in rapid prototyping, software coding, and problem-solving across various computing domains, including web development, mobile applications, and artificial intelligence. The event features a live grilling station serving freshly cooked burgers—including vegetarian options—alongside a selection of sides and refreshments. play some tunes on guitars

The Music Club Jam offers a collaborative environment for student musicians to practice and perform guitar arrangements together. During this session, participants will engage in informal jam sessions featuring both acoustic and electric guitars across various musical genres. Activities include rehearsing popular songs, exploring original chord progressions, and practicing group improvisation. Guitarists of all skill levels will have the opportunity to refine their playing techniques, share musical concepts, and collaborate with fellow campus musicians.
